title: Custom Dictionary Implementation
description: Implement a custom dictionary that supports adding, removing, and retrieving key-value pairs. Input will be a series of commands to manipulate the dictionary. ADD key - adds a key with a default value of None, prints [CREATED]; REMOVE key - removes the key from the dictionary, prints [REMOVED]; SET key value - sets the value for the specified key, prints [SET TO <value>], if no value is provided prints [ERROR - NO VALUE]; GET key - prints the current value for the specified key. If any operation besides ADD is performed on a non-existent key, print [ERROR - NOT FOUND]; if an unknown command is given, print [ERROR - UNKNOWN COMMAND], if a key is not provided print [ERROR - NO KEY]; END - ends the input processing. If ADD is called on an existing key, print [ERROR - ALREADY EXISTS].
sample_input:
ADD name
SET name Alice
ADD surname
SET surname Smith
GET name
GET surname
REMOVE name
GET name
END
sample_output:
[CREATED]
[SET TO Alice]
[CREATED]
[SET TO Smith]
Alice
Smith
[REMOVED]
[ERROR - NOT FOUND]
